finalists.label: Psoriasis
finalists.why: It has the most specific for evidence, including pruritic plaques and hyperkeratotic plaques with thick adherent scales.

finalists.label: Eczema
finalists.why: It has for evidence that is not shared with other candidates in the group, including pruritic plaques and lack of improvement with topical corticosteroids.

finalists.label: Lichen planus
finalists.why: It has the most specific for evidence in the group, including pruritic plaques and hyperkeratotic plaques with thick adherent scales and a peripheral rim of erythema.

frontier_selector.why: Psoriasis is chosen because it accounts for the most decisive findings in the vignette, including hyperkeratosis, parakeratosis, and a perivascular lymphocytic infiltrate.
